## About

I am a Ph.D. candidate in **Control Science and Engineering** at **Shanghai Jiao Tong University**. My research focuses on **optimization**, **forecasting**, **quantitative modeling**, and **data-informed decision methods** for civil infrastructure and large-scale operational applications.

::: {.hero-lead}
I work across forecasting, system modeling, optimization, and practical implementation, with an emphasis on decision-support methods for energy and water applications.
:::

## Research Highlights

::: {.card-list}
::: {.entry-card}
#### Optimization and Decision Methods
I study how predictive models and optimization procedures can be combined to support better downstream decisions in practical settings.
:::
::: {.entry-card}
#### Forecasting and Quantitative Modeling
I combine forecasting, system modeling, domain-informed structure, and operator knowledge to build analytical methods for real operational settings.
:::
::: {.entry-card}
#### Reliable Implementation
I design quantitative workflows with validation checks, careful evaluation, and user-facing interfaces for long-running real-world applications.
:::
:::
